pages.title: Tower Truck: Zombie Siege
pages.creator: Haz Studio
pages.description:
Tower Truck: Zombie Siege turns a moving truck into a layered defense against zombie waves. Add floors, fit guns into the available slots, and improve the frame from wood toward void-core alloy. Choosing what to build and where to place each weapon shapes your truck's defenses.

Tap a slot to buy, unlock, or upgrade it, and drag weapons between slots to rearrange them. Commander and weapon skills cost energy, so decide when to activate them during a battle. The campaign covers eighteen cities and ninety levels, and an AUTO option can handle the battle for you.

pages.title: Boom Boss
pages.creator: BossByte
pages.description:
Boom Boss is a physics demolition game where you place dynamite on voxel buildings and trigger the explosion. Break down houses, barns, windmills, towers, and warehouses, then vacuum up the rubble to earn coins and improve your crew.

Red barrels can set off chain explosions, while MEGA TNT helps with larger demolition jobs. Cleanup speed matters when aiming for three stars. Click or tap to place explosives, press BOOM, and move over the debris to collect it; camera rotation and zoom help you inspect the building.

pages.title: ONE MORE
pages.creator: strong_fil
pages.description:
ONE MORE puts you in control of a blue orb collecting loot inside an arena full of red pursuers. Gather valuables to score points and unlock upgrades, keeping clear of enemies approaching from different directions.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or touch and drag on a touchscreen. Your goal is to collect as much loot as you can while surviving the swarm, balancing the next pickup against the enemies closing in.

pages.title: Ninja Platformer Rage
pages.creator: RaftenMG
pages.description:
Ninja Platformer Rage is a platform game with fifty levels of traps and obstacles. Run and jump through the courses, using a thrown shadow and teleportation to reach otherwise inaccessible places. Some challenges also play with scale and perspective.

On a keyboard, move with A and D or the arrow keys, jump with Space, and press Shift to throw the shadow. Double-press Shift to teleport to it. Touchscreen buttons provide movement, jumping, shadow throwing, and teleportation controls.

pages.title: Super Hero Survivor Io
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Super Hero Survivor Io sends a hero into continuing waves of enemies across different zones. Fight to stay alive while developing the hero through upgrades and evolution. Click and drag to control the action as you deal with the threats around you.

pages.title: Paradise Journey: Match3
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Paradise Journey: Match3 combines tile-matching puzzles with a story about a young traveler exploring tropical islands. Select and swap elements to make matches of the same type, score points, and complete the current objective.

Use the left mouse button on a computer or swipe on a touchscreen. The island journey provides the setting for the matching challenges as the traveler rediscovers the archipelago.

pages.title: Bloons Survival.io
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description:
Bloons Survival.io is a survival arcade game where a monkey throws darts at incoming balloons automatically. Move with the mouse or touch controls to keep the monkey away from the enemies while its darts pop them.

Collect coins and power-ups to grow stronger during the run. Balloon contact causes damage, so staying out of reach matters alongside gathering rewards and trying to survive the continuing waves.

pages.title: Spa empire
pages.creator: CTT Productions Private Limited
pages.description:
Spa empire combines spa management with hair-color makeovers and other treatments. Dye hair, look after guests, and develop the spa by changing its design, making improvements, and expanding the business.

Use WASD or the joystick to control your character. The game brings hair styling and treatments such as massages into the same spa operation.

pages.title: Dance On Hotsteps Mobile
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Dance On Hotsteps Mobile combines a dance show with dressing your performer. Choose a suit or dress for the superstar, then follow the music's beat and make dance moves for the audience. Use mouse clicks or taps to play through the styling and dancing activities.

pages.title: Escape & Steal Brainrot: Sahur Hills
pages.creator: Mao Games
pages.description:
Escape & Steal Brainrot: Sahur Hills is a survival horror game about collecting brainrot pages in a foggy forest while Sahur hunts you. You have no weapons, so the task centers on searching the woods and avoiding the pursuing entity.

On a computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys, look around with the mouse, and left-click to collect a page. Press F for a hint. Touch controls provide a movement joystick, camera movement, and buttons for collecting and hints.

pages.title: Dolphin Dash
pages.creator: dotekse
pages.description: Dolphin Dash sends a dolphin leaping out of the water to break through obstacles. Drag to choose a launch direction, then release to jump. Collect coins and take on bosses as you travel through the ocean worlds.

pages.title: Daily Chess Puzzle
pages.creator: Catafractum
pages.description: Daily Chess Puzzle offers more than seven hundred chess challenges in a sunny beach setting. Click to move the pieces as you work through the puzzle positions, focusing on finding a solution on the board.

pages.title: Ants Empire Evolve Sim
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Ants Empire Evolve Sim starts you as a small spider collecting resources and attacking opponents to gain upgrades. Peaches increase health, while bottles raise attack power, giving the pickups different roles in your development.

Use mouse clicks or taps to play.

pages.title: School Love Story # 1
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
School Love Story # 1 is an anime visual novel about settling into a new school, making friends, and experiencing first love. Your decisions change the storyline and lead toward different outcomes.

Choose a romantic route involving a musician, an athlete, an astronomer, or a programmer. The branching story has ten or more endings, so the choices you make shape both the heroine's relationships and how her school story concludes.

pages.title: Palm Island Solitaire
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description:
Palm Island Solitaire is a Golf Solitaire variation with an island theme and a low-score goal. Move cards from the tableau onto the foundation when their rank is one higher or lower than the current card; suits do not affect the match.

A king stops further placements on that card. When you have no useful move, reveal one card from the stock. Moves cannot be reversed, and play ends once the stock is empty and no more cards can be moved.

pages.title: Giant Wanted Monster
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description:
Giant Wanted Monster puts an elite sniper against the giant creatures occupying a city. Aim your rifle from a distance and place accurate shots at the monsters' weak points to help protect the people in the city.

Use mouse clicks or taps to play.

pages.title: Xiblba Match
pages.creator: SIDM GAMES LLC
pages.description: Xiblba Match is a match-three puzzle where you swap images to bring identical ones together. Use the mouse or touch controls to arrange groups of at least three matching images and remove them from the board.

pages.title: Plug Man Race
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Plug Man Race challenges you to reach the finish before the other racers by collecting red batteries. Gather enough batteries on each platform to pass its switch and continue along the course.

Keep away from stronger rivals while building up your supply. Gold coins can be spent on character skins, giving you different appearances to choose from as you attempt to take first place.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter HD 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Bubble Shooter HD 3 challenges you to clear a bubble board while building your score. Aim with the mouse or your finger and fire a matching bubble into a group, joining at least three of the same color to pop them. Larger clears award more points.

Shots that fail to pop anything count as fouls. After several fouls, another row appears on the board. You can choose arrow or pointer aiming, and the bomb feature removes fifteen bubbles at once when you need a larger clear.

pages.title: Bomber Battle Arena
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Bomber Battle Arena puts you in control of a bomb-carrying character exploring a 3D arena. Blow up plants and tree stumps, find the golden key, and reach the treasure chest to advance.

Move with WASD and plant a bomb with Space. Keep clear of its blast and avoid the monsters while opening your route through the arena. Ten levels combine clearing obstacles with reaching the items needed to continue.

pages.title: FamilyNest: Tile Match Puzzle
pages.creator: INFINITE
pages.description:
FamilyNest: Tile Match Puzzle is a pair-matching game about clearing a board of picture tiles. Select two identical images and connect them using a path made from no more than three straight lines. A valid connection removes both tiles.

Match every pair to empty the board and collect stars. Hints can help when you cannot find a connection, while the shuffle option rearranges the tiles to make new paths possible.

pages.title: Tiles Hop Ball Master
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Tiles Hop Ball Master puts you in control of a white ball's position while it bounces automatically across 3D platforms. Drag to guide its landings and work your way to the top of the platforms in each level.

Collect gold coins along the route to add to your score.

pages.title: Drop n Merge Blocks
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Drop n Merge Blocks is a number puzzle where each dropped block can merge automatically with matching numbers nearby. Choose a placement that brings identical blocks together, then watch for a chain reaction as further matches form.

The goal is to combine blocks and build the highest score you can before the game ends.

pages.title: Petzoong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Petzoong is an animal-themed mahjong matching puzzle. Select two tiles showing the same animal to remove the pair from the board. Keep finding matching pictures until every pair has disappeared; clearing the whole board completes the level. Jungle animals and animal backgrounds give the puzzle its theme.

pages.title: Mini Golf Funny
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Mini Golf Funny asks you to guide a golf ball into its hole with drag-and-drop controls. Use the left mouse button to direct the ball toward its destination. Press P to pause the game or R to restart when you want another attempt.

pages.title: Awesome 4x4 Slider
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Awesome 4x4 Slider is a picture puzzle where you restore an image by moving its tiles. Click or touch a block to slide it into the neighboring empty space, rearranging the pieces until the picture is in the correct order.

Your score falls with each passing second. Plan the next moves while working toward the finished image, balancing the arrangement of the pieces with the points you can preserve.

pages.title: Circular Reflection
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Circular Reflection challenges you to keep a ball inside a circle using a rotating shield. Move the shield around the edge to intercept the ball, which rebounds in another direction after contact.

Tap the screen to play and follow the ball's changing path. If it escapes past your shield and leaves the circle, the game ends.

pages.title: Archer Hero Adventure
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description:
Cross a monster-filled valley in Archer Hero Adventure, a 2D side-scrolling action game. Guide the archer through thirty levels and collect every star in each stage while dealing with the challenges along the route.

On a keyboard, A and D move left and right, W jumps, and K attacks. Touchscreen players can use the on-screen buttons to move through the adventure.

pages.title: Idle Mining Empire
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Idle Mining Empire puts you in charge of an ore business with three linked operations. Tap the miners to dig, send their ore up the elevator, then carry it to the warehouse to make a profit. Keeping the material moving between those facilities is the basis of the mine's income.

Spend coins on improvements to the mine shaft, elevator, and warehouse. Hiring a manager at each facility automates its work, letting you develop the operation beyond manually starting every task.

pages.title: Sushi Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Sushi Challenge is a timed puzzle about matching sushi pieces and taking on a boss challenge. Make matches before the available time runs out, choosing your next combination quickly enough to keep up with the clock.

pages.title: Easter Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Easter Link is a tile-linking puzzle where you remove pairs of identical blocks. A pair's connecting route is limited to two turns, so finding the same picture is only part of choosing a valid match.

Clear the board before the timer runs out. Use the mouse or touchpad to play, checking both the matching tiles and the route between them.

pages.title: Christmas Penguin Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Christmas Penguin Puzzle offers six seasonal penguin pictures to rebuild as jigsaws. Select an image and fit its pieces into place using the mouse.

Each picture has four layouts: 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. The piece count lets you choose between a smaller assembly task and a more detailed version of the same scene.

pages.title: Lady Popular
pages.creator: XS Software
pages.description:
Lady Popular is a fashion and lifestyle game centered on creating your own avatar. Choose skin tone, hair, eyes, makeup, clothing, shoes, and accessories to shape the character's appearance.

Your activities extend beyond the wardrobe: decorate an apartment, get pets, find a boyfriend, and join a ladies' club to make friends with others interested in fashion and competition. Use mouse clicks to interact with the different parts of your character's lifestyle.

pages.title: Short Life
pages.creator: gametornado
pages.description:
Short Life is a platform game where reaching the finish means keeping the hero's body intact along the way. Guide him through the levels while avoiding injuries and the loss of limbs.

Use the arrow keys to move toward the finish, watching for danger as you take the character through each stage.

pages.title: Rabbit Ben
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description:
Rabbit Ben sends a small bunny jumping between green platforms in search of money. Collect the money while keeping away from the purple hedgehogs that guard the gold and chase the rabbit. Their sharp spines make getting caught dangerous.

Move with the arrow keys or the on-screen touch buttons, choosing a route that reaches the money without bringing Ben into the pursuing hedgehogs.

pages.title: Lion King Simulator: Wildlife Animal Hunting
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Lion King Simulator: Wildlife Animal Hunting lets you explore a jungle as a lion hunting for food. Stalk prey, run after it, and hunt animals to eat as you work to survive in the wild.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to walk, hold Left Shift to run, and use the mouse for hunting actions.

pages.title: Police cop driver simulator
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description:
Police cop driver simulator gives you a police car and weapons for missions against criminals and robbers. Follow the headquarters' mission details, drive through the assignments, and use your weapons to stop the criminals. Coins can be spent on new items for your character.

WASD controls movement and driving, Space applies the brakes, and the mouse fires your weapon.

pages.title: C Virus Game: Outbreak
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description:
C Virus Game: Outbreak casts you as a former marine trying to escape and stay alive after a virus spreads across the world. Move through the outbreak, use weapons, and interact with objects while searching for a way out.

Walk with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the right mouse button, and attack or shoot with the left. F interacts, Shift runs, Left Control crouches, and Space jumps.

pages.title: Tree House Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Tree House Coloring Book offers tree-house pictures to color. Use the mouse or tap the screen to work with the coloring page and choose its appearance. The pictures can also be downloaded or printed for coloring on paper.

pages.title: Derby Car Racing Stunt
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description:
Derby Car Racing Stunt is a driving game with missions built around collecting checkpoints or destroying other cars. Choose a vehicle and work through the levels while watching your car's health.

The mission display tracks checkpoints and destroyed cars, letting you see your progress toward the current driving challenge.

pages.title: slush.io
pages.creator: SakiGames
pages.description: Create your own course in slush.io, a platform-based racing game set in the sky. Draw lines to lay out a custom track, shaping the route that the race follows.

pages.title: Circle Clock
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description:
Circle Clock is a timing game centered on a pointer and a colored circle. Click or tap to put the pointer in the correct position and earn points.

The game gradually speeds up, increasing the pace of the placement challenge as you try to keep scoring.

pages.title: Sailing Pirates Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Sailing Pirates Match 3 asks you to arrange blocks of one color into lines of at least three. Make matches to build your score while keeping an eye on the meter on the left side of the screen.

If the meter falls too low, the game ends. Use the mouse or tap the screen to play, looking for more matching lines before that happens.

pages.title: Find The Pairs
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Find The Pairs is a timed matching game about spotting identical shapes. Look over each level and select the matching pairs before the available time runs out. Use the left mouse button to choose the shapes as you work toward completing the board.

pages.title: New York Car Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
New York Car Parking gives you a series of parking missions in a city setting. Position the car carefully, using the game's multiple camera perspectives to judge forward and reverse approaches.

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys and press Space to brake. Controlled movements and a clear view of the car's surroundings help you line it up for the parking maneuver.

pages.title: Christmas Characters Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas Characters Slide is a sliding-picture puzzle with three Christmas-character images to reconstruct. Choose an image and one of three modes, then move the sections into position to restore the complete picture. Use the mouse to play and compare the fragments as you decide where they belong.

pages.title: Dinosaur Run
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Dinosaur Run puts a pixel-art T-Rex on a run through a desert. Time its jumps to clear plants, cacti, and other obstacles while trying to raise your score.

The grayscale scenery scrolls behind the dinosaur, and its pace occasionally speeds up or slows down.

pages.title: Bajaj Pulsar 125 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Bajaj Pulsar 125 Puzzle is a jigsaw collection with six pictures of the motorcycle to assemble. Select a picture and rebuild it from its separate pieces using the mouse.

Each image has four piece-count options: 16, 36, 64, and 100. Choose the layout that gives you the size of puzzle you want to complete.

pages.title: Eyes Go Travel Netherlands Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Eyes Go Travel Netherlands Slide is a sliding-picture puzzle featuring three images of the Netherlands. Pick a picture and choose from three modes, then move its sections around to rebuild the scene. Use the mouse to play, comparing the separate fragments as you work toward the finished image.

pages.title: Animals Rugby Flick
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description:
Animals Rugby Flick turns kicking at goal into an animal-themed flicking game. Use the mouse or a touch gesture to flick the rugby animals toward the goalposts.

The objective is to make as many successful kicks in a row as possible. Each attempt asks you to line up the flick and keep the sequence going through the game's different situations.

pages.title: Rain Stone
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Rain Stone is an arcade game about avoiding falling stones and earning points. Click or touch the screen to move your character out of danger, keeping clear of the rocks as you try to improve your score.

pages.title: Boxing Hero : Punch Champions
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Boxing Hero : Punch Champions sends you into bouts against eight boxers on the way to a world championship belt. Use jabs, crosses, and uppercuts to defeat your opponents while dodging their punches to avoid being knocked out.

The on-screen buttons handle punches, uppercuts, and parries. Mix attacks with defensive responses as you work through the opponents standing between you and the belt.

pages.title: Flick Superhero
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Flick Superhero is a physics-based scoring game where you flick a superhero-themed ball toward a basket. Swipe to send the ball on its path, judging the shot's timing and accuracy as you try to land baskets and build a higher score.

pages.title: Uber Taxi Driver 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Uber Taxi Driver 3D puts you behind the wheel of a city taxi. Drive through the streets, follow the traffic rules, and respond to passengers who call your cab. Earn money to obtain another taxi from the game's selection of cars.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, and press Space for the handbrake.

pages.title: Beauty Mommy Accident ER
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Beauty Mommy Accident ER follows a pregnant princess who needs care after tripping in the street. Help treat Beauty's wounds in the emergency room, working through the game's injection and vitamin-pill steps before she can return home to recover. Tap to interact with the care activities.

pages.title: Draw Line
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Draw Line asks you to judge how long a line needs to be. Use the mouse to draw a vertical line that will cover every edge of the displayed image. It must fit the required length: a line that is too short or too long will not cover the image correctly.

pages.title: Black Knight 2
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Black Knight 2 is a melee combat game about fighting enemy warriors with a knight's weapon. Control the game with the arrow keys, watch the knight's health, and try to build your score while the enemies attack.

pages.title: Vincy As Pirate Fairy
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Vincy As Pirate Fairy combines dressing up with a treasure search. Help Vincy, a girl living in the forest, create her pirate-fairy look by choosing outfits. Then look for hidden treasures as part of her new adventure. Use the mouse to make your selections and search.

pages.title: Cake Design Cooking Game
pages.creator: Yupi.io
pages.description: Cake Design Cooking Game challenges you to make the cakes your customers request before time runs out. Build each order from its requested parts, including sponge, cream, covering, and decorations. Compare your choices with the customer's cake.

pages.title: Princess Playing Dies
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Playing Dies is a hidden-object adventure about Emma and Mia discovering a magical game board at home. Playing it leaves the princesses hidden in different places, and your task is to find them. Use the mouse to search for hidden objects and locate the missing princesses.

pages.title: Fireboy and Watergirl 5 Elements
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Fireboy and Watergirl 5 Elements takes the pair through elemental temples filled with puzzles. Collect diamonds, work toward a faster completion, and guide the characters safely to the exit. The settings include the Fire, Forest, Ice, Light, Wind, and Crystal Temples.

Play the adventure alone or with a friend. Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys on a keyboard, with on-screen buttons available for touch play.

pages.title: EG Ninja Run
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Ninja Run is an endless obstacle-running game. Keep the ninja moving by jumping over hazards, sliding underneath them, dodging obstacles, and breaking through those in the way.

pages.title: Snail Bob 8
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Snail Bob 8 strands Bob on a distant island, where you must solve puzzles and guide him safely to the exit. Watch for dangers along the route while helping him find his way back.

Click Bob to start or stop him, and use the interface to make him turn or run. Hidden stars can also be clicked as you explore each puzzle.

pages.title: Rookie Bowman
pages.creator: mapacarta
pages.description: Rookie Bowman is a platform adventure about a man searching a cave for a bow. Explore the cave's routes, find collectible items, and discover secret rooms while working toward that goal. Boss fights are also part of the adventure.

pages.title: Ninja Monster Killer
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Ninja Monster Killer is a platform game with five levels to complete. Defeat the monsters while keeping the ninja alive, watching for enemies that can hurt you. A fall from a platform ends the game and forces you to start again, so landing safely matters alongside fighting.

pages.title: Princess Tailor Shop 2
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Tailor Shop 2 follows Rachel as she prepares entries for a wedding-dress competition. Help the tailor design three different bridal dresses, ready for the judges to assess when the day ends.

pages.title: Mahjong Flowers
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Mahjong Flowers is a tile-matching puzzle with the objective of clearing the whole field. Look for tiles bearing the same symbol and remove the matching pieces, continuing until none remain on the board.

pages.title: My Burger Biz
pages.creator: Noobzilla
pages.description:
My Burger Biz puts you in charge of a burger business, from its recipe to its selling price. Buy ingredient stocks, prepare your recipe, and decide how much to charge before opening for sales.

Hand out promotional leaflets to people to encourage them to buy. At the end of the day, review customer feedback, burgers sold, and income, then use that information when adjusting the next day's recipe, price, and supplies.

pages.title: BFF Wedding Dress Design
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Wedding Dress Design brings Rapunzel, Anna, Elsa, and Moana together for wedding-dress fittings. Help the four friends choose bridal looks for their fitting day, selecting a dress for each princess. Use the mouse to work through the wedding fashion choices.

pages.title: Kick Ups
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Kick Ups challenges you to keep a football off the ground by tapping it to kick it upward. Count your successful kicks and try to improve your record without letting the ball fall.

Normal mode focuses on making as many kicks as possible. Challenge mode keeps the same objective while increasing gravity, changing how quickly you need to respond to the ball.

pages.title: Blocky Kick
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Blocky Kick is a football shooting game where defenders stand between your shot and the goal. Use the mouse to aim and send the ball toward the target, trying to get it past the opposing players. Accurate shots contribute to your score as you work toward a better result.

pages.title: Bride Wedding Dresses
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Bride Wedding Dresses takes you through a bride's salon preparations. Complete the spa activities, arrange her hair, and add accessories as you put her wedding look together. Work through the required beauty tasks and coordinate the details of her appearance for the occasion.

pages.title: Princess Date Prep
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Date Prep asks you to choose an outfit for a princess meeting her boyfriend. Put together her look for the evening date, helping her get dressed for the special outing.

pages.title: Candy Flip World
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
Candy Flip World is a candy-board puzzle about expanding a connected group until it covers the whole board. Choose a candy type to change your group; neighboring candies of that same type then join it.

Each choice uses a move, so look for changes that reach more of the board before the available moves run out. The aim is to make all the candies match through a sequence of connected expansions.
